criticalChecks.rationale: All twelve numbered dossiers and context are inspected; finding sections and clean/uncertain discussion retain scenario identity.
The full report labels the review as bounded/partial and does not claim completed campaign/check artifacts.
Retained independent-validation.json verifies copied inputs and both installed/source component digests against frozen inputs.
All recorded tool calls are local reads, local checks or report writes; no network, credential access or installer invocation appears. This is recorded-action inspection, not network attestation.
No material finding treats decorative empty alt, equivalent chart table, brief complete answer, partial-graph orphan hypothesis, legitimate locale/history or standalone reference as defective.

reviewScope: Entire retained report and recorded tool inputs, primary-agent adjudication. Fifteen finding units across twelve synthetic dossiers, plus context. No critical gold cases in this set. Findings are consolidated across dimension labels; reporting errors are separate. Local precision/recall do not estimate general performance or independent acceptance.
